record_rate_limit_or_deferred_rate_limit.rationale: route is authenticated, role-gated, same-practice scoped, read-only, paginated, and not exposed to external patient clients; production/public exposure still requires rate-limit review
record_rate_limit_or_deferred_rate_limit.accepted_risk: a compromised or malicious authenticated staff credential could enumerate the practitioner directory at high request rate without a route-specific middleware throttle
current_controls: Cloud Run request concurrency as a soft ceiling, not a per-user rate limit

name_deployment_surface.current_surface: FastAPI backend route mounted under /api/v1/practice for authenticated internal staff clients
name_deployment_surface.development_surface: local uvicorn app.main:app development backend, with ngrok used only as a development tunnel for add-in access when needed
name_deployment_surface.future_surface: GCP Cloud Run FastAPI backend internal staff API deployment only; no public patient-client deployment surface is approved

record_rls_or_rls_equivalent_gap.current_control: application-layer tenancy filter Practitioner.practice_id == current_user.practice_id plus route tests
record_rls_or_rls_equivalent_gap.gap: PostgreSQL RLS is not yet enabled as a database-level backstop for this read model
record_rls_or_rls_equivalent_gap.residual_risk: a future ORM query, raw SQL path, migration script, or route variant that omits the practice_id filter could return cross-practice practitioner data without a database-level backstop

record_field_encryption_gap.current_control: PractitionerOut excludes sensitive identifiers and route tests assert response absence
record_field_encryption_gap.gap: Practitioner model may store provider_number, prescriber_number, ahpra_number, and hpi_i without field-level encryption
record_field_encryption_gap.residual_risk: a database-level breach, SQL injection elsewhere, or compromised database credential could expose these identifiers in plaintext; API schema exclusion does not mitigate that storage risk

future_external_exposure_requires: PostgreSQL RLS or approved RLS-equivalent control
route or shared middleware rate limiting
privacy impact assessment for exposing practitioner role and location information
patient identity proofing and authentication distinct from staff auth
separate Yuri approval payload for external-client exposure

create_separate_yuri_approval_payload_fo.rationale: Sprint 258 closes blocker evidence only; it intentionally stops before approval-payload creation or readiness flag change

next_required_decision: Yuri must explicitly decide whether to authorize a separate rest_route_ready=true approval payload for this route only
